_comment: THE TRAVEL DATASET. This is the search space the Rust itinerary generator walks when it builds a trip:
pick a country, pick 1-3 of its cities, pick activities whose tags overlap the pod's travel personalities,
pick one hotel per night at the pod's budget tier, and chain the cities together with transport_to legs.
WHERE IT CAME FROM
- src/lib/travelDataset.js covered five 'focus countries' in depth: Japan, United Kingdom, USA, China and
Australia. Activity ids, names, emoji, durations and style tags for those five are ported verbatim.
- src/lib/peapodData.js (the destinationContent map) covered the Asian short-haul destinations the Decide
Together queue keeps referencing: Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, Taiwan, South Korea, Indonesia, Singapore
and Hong Kong. Those activity titles, emoji and notes are ported from there.
- Region coordinates come from src/lib/countryStates.js (real lat/lng, used to place the dots on the
region-picker map) for Japan, USA, China, Australia and the UK. Regions for the other eight countries
were taken from the countryRegions map in peapodData.js and given real coordinates.
MONEY
Every *_minor field is an INTEGER in the MINOR UNIT of that country's own currency, never a float and
never a string. Which is why each country carries a currency code: 3000 under Japan is 3000 yen, 3000
under the UK is 3000 pence. Currencies with no sub-unit in practice use an exponent of 0, so one minor
unit is one whole unit:
exponent 0 (minor unit == whole unit) : JPY, KRW, VND, IDR
exponent 2 (minor unit == 1/100)      : GBP, USD, CNY, AUD, THB, MYR, TWD, HKD, SGD
All costs are PER PERSON. flight_cost_minor_by_tier is the return fare from the pod's home city
(Singapore) to that country's main hub, so Singapore's own entry is legitimately zero.
JUDGEMENT CALLS, so nobody has to guess later
1. The original files stored prices as plain Singapore-dollar demo numbers with no currency attached.
Converting them blindly would have produced absurd local prices, so every cost here is a realistic
local-currency price anchored to the original figure. Where the original figure was clearly a demo
placeholder that made no sense locally (Kyoto to Osaka was priced at roughly ten times the real JR
fare) the real fare is used instead.
2. travelDataset.js had two copy-paste bugs that produced a literal tag of "free", which is not in the
tag vocabulary: lv_bellagio and london_british. Both are genuinely free to enter, so they carry the
'budget' tag here instead.
3. The eight short-haul countries had activities in peapodData.js but no hotels and no intercity
transport at all. Those hotels and transport legs are invented but plausible, and every one of those
countries says so in its own _comment.
4. Chengdu had no mid-tier hotel in the source; one was added so all three tiers exist everywhere.
5. Singapore is a city-state. Its three 'cities' are really the districts the original app treated as
destinations (Marina Bay, Sentosa, Joo Chiat), and its transport legs are MRT rides.
VOCABULARIES (fixed - the generator matches against these, so do not invent new members)
kind : flight | transfer | hotel | activity | meal | train | free
tags : relaxed fast adventure luxury budget food nature culture shopping family romantic photo night
themepark history local
The tag list is exactly the travelPersonalities id list, which is what lets the generator score an
activity against a pod's declared travel style with a plain set intersection.

countries.name: Japan
countries._comment: Ported from travelDataset.js COUNTRIES.japan. Regions are the 15 prefecture-level dots from countryStates.js. Prices are real yen: the Tokyo-Kyoto Shinkansen at 13000 is the actual reserved-seat fare, 18000 is the Green Car.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries._comment: Ported from travelDataset.js COUNTRIES.uk, plus the hand-crafted London and Edinburgh days from ukItinerarySeed in peapodData.js (Dishoom, the West End show, The Witchery, the Highlands tour). Regions are the 15 real dots from countryStates.js. Only four of the seventeen source cities are carried over; the others had thinner pools and can be added later without a schema change.

transport_to.title: LNER Azuma back to King's Cross

countries.name: USA
countries._comment: Ported from travelDataset.js COUNTRIES.usa, with the New York, Los Angeles and San Francisco day pools from peapodData.js folded in. All 21 real state dots from countryStates.js are kept so the region-picker map still works, even though only four cities are modelled here. Intercity legs are domestic flights lifted from the source flights array; there is no drive-yourself option in the dataset because the original app never modelled car hire.

countries.name: China
countries._comment: Ported from travelDataset.js COUNTRIES.china plus the Beijing / Shanghai / Chengdu day pools in peapodData.js. The region list is the 16 real dots from countryStates.js and includes Hong Kong, because the original region-picker map drew it as a selectable dot on the China outline; Hong Kong also exists here as its own country entry for the short-haul trips the decision queue proposes. Chengdu had no mid-tier hotel in the source, so one was added.

countries.name: Australia
countries._comment: Ported from travelDataset.js COUNTRIES.australia plus the Sydney / Melbourne / Cairns day pools in peapodData.js. Regions are the 13 real dots from countryStates.js, which deliberately mixes states with a few standalone cities (Cairns, Brisbane, Gold Coast) because that is how the original picker let people choose. Intercity legs are the domestic flights from the source flights array; the source also had two long rail options that are omitted here because they are slower and more expensive than flying on every route the generator would use.

activities.title: Sunset drinks at a harbour rooftop
Coffee crawl through the CBD lanes

countries.name: Thailand
countries._comment: Thailand was never one of the five focus countries, so travelDataset.js has nothing for it. Activities come from the Bangkok / Chiang Mai / Krabi pools in peapodData.js destinationContent, plus the Phuket days the pod actually completed in mockScenarios.js. HOTELS AND INTERCITY TRANSPORT ARE INVENTED: no source file had any. They are typical published prices for each tier and are safe to replace with real inventory later. Regions are the eight provinces the app referenced, with real coordinates.

activities.title: Longtail boat on the Chao Phraya
Free afternoon around the hotel pool

transport_to.title: Overnight sleeper train to Chiang Mai

countries.name: Malaysia
countries._comment: Activities are ported from the Kuala Lumpur / Penang / Johor / Malacca pools in peapodData.js destinationContent and from the Malaysia trips the pod completed in mockScenarios.js. HOTELS AND INTERCITY TRANSPORT ARE INVENTED for the same reason as Thailand: travelDataset.js never covered Malaysia. The flight tier is deliberately tiny because Kuala Lumpur is a one-hour hop from home and the pod has historically driven or taken a coach instead.
